artists_sort: David Munrow / Early Music Consort Of London, The
title: Instruments Of The Middle Ages And Renaissance
notes:
℗ 1976 EMI Records Ltd.

On labels: MADE IN GT BRITAIN
On leaflet: Printed in Great Britain.
On spine: 0C 193 ○ 06057-8

Included is a 96-page book about the instruments of the Middle Ages & Renaissance, written by David Munrow.
It is an elaborate description with lots of photo's in black & white. The front and back cover are also in black & white.
It has been published by EMI Records Ltd. by arrangement with Oxford University Press (ISBN 0 19 321321 4).
This version (in the foreword) © Oxford University Press 1976 First published 1976. Twice reprinted 1976.

The textured box also contains a 6-page folded leaflet the size of the box.
It describes all the tracks on the recording and has liner notes in English by David Munrow.

Cover illustration: Details from "Hearing" by Jan Breughel (1568-1625), Prado, Madrid.
Runouts are stamped.
